summary: Mechanical Engineering undergraduate at the University of Minho with a strong interest in the intersection of engineering, technology, and artificial intelligence. Comfortable moving between CAD modeling, analytical/simulation work in Python, and AI-assisted software development, with a track record of applying that range to real prototypes — including a 1st-place competition vehicle — and to personal software projects built end-to-end.

education.details: Coursework and projects spanning solid mechanics, dynamics, CAD/CAM, manufacturing processes, and simulation-driven design.
highlights: Development of Formula Water, a vehicle prototype powered by water's potential energy.
Study of system dynamics, motion transmission, friction, stability, and center of mass.
Use of Python for simulations and results analysis, and SolidWorks/Solid Edge for modeling mechanical components.

experienceSummary: Independent, project-based experience rather than formal employment to date: every entry on this CV's Projects section was scoped, executed, and (where applicable) manufactured or tested by me, individually or as part of a competition team.

awards.title: 1st Place — University of Minho Competition
awards.description: Formula Water: gravity-powered vehicle prototype, awarded for overall performance and engineering execution.
